entity.name: Christ Tamil Church Chicago
entity.name_collision_warning: 'Chicago Tamil Church' (Westchester / Hickory Hills, also abbreviated 'CTC') is a different congregation. Always use the full name 'Christ Tamil Church' and pair it with 'Downers Grove' in titles, schema, and listings.
entity.tradition: Protestant, Bible-based, Trinitarian (see beliefs). Denomination not stated in the repo.
entity.mission_quote: Our goal is to revive believers, live by love, and provide a Bible-based home church for Tamil families in the Chicago area.
mission_pillars: Create a place for Tamil families to worship and praise God in Tamil.
Deepen our relationship with Jesus, become alive in Christ, and serve others.
Support people in need and take part in mission throughout Chicagoland.
Pass faith, family values, and Tamil cultural identity to the next generation.

senior_pastor.note: Leadership asked to leave the pastor unnamed. Do not name a pastor in content, schema, or listings.

founded.note: Use in schema (foundingDate), Visit copy, and the Google Business Profile ('Serving Chicagoland since 2015').

media_library.claim: More than 10 years of worship, teaching, celebrations, and ministry videos
media_library.seo_value: Each video can carry VideoObject schema, and Tamil sermon titles match long-tail Tamil-language searches.

differentiators.claim: Bilingual Tamil and English worship, so second-generation and non-Tamil spouses are included
A structured children's track with two parts: Kids Circle within worship and B.L.A.S.T. Sunday School
Some of the most frequent weekday gatherings among Chicago Tamil churches: Friday Bible study, Mon–Thu prayer, monthly fasting prayer
Passing on Tamil culture and language as an explicit mission pillar
A large, searchable video archive (160+ videos)
A full yearly family calendar: VBS, June picnic, Labor Day family camp, Harvest Festival, carol rounds
Morning Sunday service at 10:30 AM. Other Tamil churches meet at 12:30 PM and 2:30 PM

technical_seo_state.hosting: GitHub Pages (christ-tamil-church/christ-tamil-church.github.io) via .github/workflows/deploy.yml, deploys from main
technical_seo_state.rendering: Prerendered at build time (src/entry-server.tsx + scripts/prerender.mjs). Each route ships dist/<route>/index.html with full body content; the browser then renders the app as before.
technical_seo_state.per_route_meta: src/seo.ts pageMeta: title, description, canonical, Open Graph and Twitter tags baked into each page's static HTML and kept in sync on client navigation by Layout.tsx.
technical_seo_state.structured_data: Church+Organization and WebSite JSON-LD on every page, BreadcrumbList on inner pages, VideoObject on /sermons, AudioObject list on /sermons/audio-archive.
technical_seo_state.sitemap: dist/sitemap.xml generated from pageMeta (no lastmod: a build date on every URL is ignored by Google)
technical_seo_state.legacy_urls: Static meta-refresh + canonical pages for every legacyRedirects entry (old .com URLs)
technical_seo_state.not_found: dist/404.html prerendered from NotFound with noindex; GitHub Pages serves it with HTTP 404
open_issues: No visible FAQ sections yet (FAQ rich results are limited to government and health sites since 2023, but visible Q&A still helps searchers and AI answers)
